verdict.rationale: Datalab is an API product, so a downloadable API spec is a fair axis, but nothing in the pack shows one. The probe found every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. What does exist doesn't count: per-endpoint API reference pages in markdown and an llms.txt docs index are documentation, not a machine-readable spec equivalent to OpenAPI. Confidence is medium because the probe checked only a limited set of candidate paths.
